column1: # analysis/naming/ram_g8.tsv -- RAM name proposals of namer 8/8 (banks 74 7C 7D 7E 7F); config/ram format: addr name size type status evidence
# NOT merged into config/ram: the orchestrator reconciles them with the existing rows ("replaces X" = current neutral name).
# WRAM D000-DFFF rows are size 1 on purpose (banked memory, see docs/research/ram_names_reconciliation.md); the true extent is in the evidence.

# Verifier note: D300-D3BF / D600-DFFD proposals are WRAM bank 6 only and overlap other passes' names for the same addresses in other banks (e.g. wMail_TextBuffer D024, bank-dependent); C2C3 = wCommSessionKind (config/ram) is what Charset_ConvertPage tests.
# Independent agreement (not repeated as rows): C0D3 = wSplitScrollY, D724 = wStatSplitLine, D824 = wStatIrqServiceFlag (ram_g4.tsv);
#   Bank 7F evidence for them: 7F:7271 zeroes C0D3 and sets D824=1; 7F:733A/7425/7578/76C4 add/subtract C0D3; 7F:61FF zeroes C266-C268; 7F:59D4-59E4 (unreferenced) compares C2D5/C2D6.

column6: evidence

replaces wRam_C0A0: 24-byte glyph buffer (12 rows x 2 plane bytes) = left 6-px half: filled by 7F:4007 (ASCII) and 7F:405F (BC from 00:1044), blitted by 7F:42C3 (00:10C6/1059); also scratch (7F:4C42, 00:0E7E)
replaces wRam_C0B8: second 24-byte buffer = right 6-px half of a wide glyph (DE argument of 7F:405F at 00:104B, blitted 6 px further right at 00:1079-109D); adjacent to wGlyphBufLeft (C0A0+24)
replaces wRam_C0D0: AND mask (bits kept) for the current tile byte, loaded from Canvas_BlitMaskCur[x&7] at 7F:4311-4316, read by every row step of 7F:42CA (24 reads)
replaces wRam_C0D1: AND mask for the next tile byte (glyph spill), loaded from Canvas_BlitMaskNext[x&7] at 7F:4319-431E, read by every row step of 7F:42CA

replaces wRam_C330: <br clear=> value 0 none, 1 left, 2 right, 3 all (Html_ClearValueNames); index of Html_BrClearJumpTable (74:4BB9 store, 74:4BE6 load); bank 51 reuses it as scratch
replaces wRam_C335: 0 = full parse+layout (Html_ParsePage 74:4220), $FF = scan only (Html_ScanPage 74:426E); non-zero makes 74:5417, 5440 and 529F return at once and routes to the URL list (74:4DF9)
replaces wRam_C336 (+C337): next free byte of the link string heap in WRAM bank 6 ($D800 at start, 74:5A96; $E0xx = full, tests at 74:4AF4/4B38); advanced by Html_Tag_A
replaces wRam_C338 (+C339): number of open tags: +1 on (74:4A6D-4A7E), -1 on (74:4A3E-4A55); the style bits hRam_FFB2&3 follow it

replaces wRam_C33C: current horizontal alignment in bits 2-3 (04 right, 08 centre, 0C left), set by <center>/<div align=> (74:47A3), read by the layout (74:4CB2, 4D2D-4D3B, 5679); saved/restored through the align stack
